title: ¡Nuestras paraguayitas de #VLT aprende la danza de la botella! 🇵🇾😍

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains foundational tips for balancing a bottle on the head while participants try out the steps. The tone is light and humorous, combining demonstration with practical advice.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the bottle dance segment with hosts and instructor.
Explaining how the bottle base sits and head placement.
Starting with a walking step before adding more movement.

common_mistakes: Placing the bottle too far back on the head

steps_taught.name: Caminata
steps_taught.description: Initial walking step while balancing a bottle on the head.

what_works: Step-by-step guidance starting from balance to walking.
what_hinders: Casual talk and distractions on a TV show format.
